messages:
Nora (CS): quick heads-up - a handful of onboarding customers saw timeouts during large-index jobs this morning. need a short status update and a credits plan we can send.
Ibrahim (Success Ops): copy that. eng/sre can you provide 1-line root cause + ETA so i can draft customer copy?
Sel (Eng): root cause: indexer queue starvation when many large documents uploaded concurrently; introduced a soft-throttle at 2025-09-10T10:40Z to smooth bursts.
Gina (SRE): impact window ~10:15-10:55 UTC, timeout spike ~7%. scaled workers and suppressed retries; metrics trending down.
Ibrahim (Success Ops): draft outbound suggestion: "Hi - we experienced intermittent onboarding timeouts affecting indexing for some customers. Status: soft-throttle deployed and monitoring in a 24h canary. Next: full rollout within 36h if stable. Compensation: a one-time onboarding credit will be applied automatically to affected accounts. Office hours: 30m Q&A tomorrow 15:00 UTC (recording available). Support: https://support.redwood.ai/onboard-help"
Nora (CS): thanks - edit to add "high-touch accounts will receive a personalized follow-up" and change wording to "one-time onboarding credit (applied automatically)".
Sel (Eng): technical note for RCA: add synthetic test for large-doc bursts and alert for queue depth > 80% sustained.
Gina (SRE): will add dashboard panel and a playbook step to bump workers for high ingestion windows.
Ibrahim (Success Ops): OpsBot, please create incident and calendar event.
OpsBot: Incident created: INC-2025-4983. Event: "Indexing impact Q&A" - 2025-09-11T15:00:00Z (30m). Recording will be attached to the incident.
Nora (CS): legal quick-check requested; target send EOD after signoff. please react with :white_check_mark: once youve reviewed the outbound copy.
Sel (Eng): :white_check_mark:
Gina (SRE): :white_check_mark:
Ibrahim (Success Ops): closing thread for now - will reopen with RCA link and recording after office hours.
